title: Removing Noise or Introducing Bias? The Hidden Cost of MSR Filtering
abstract: arXiv:2609.18953v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: OSS platforms like GitHub serve as a primary data source for MSR research. As the platform is widely used by different users, spanning from student to developer, not all repositories are actual engineered projects. Therefore, to avoid such noise, researchers often apply several criteria, which may fundamentally change the sample demographics. To understand such biases, this study aims to uncover the hidden cost originating from these arbitrary thresholds or criteria. We analyzed 1.57 million repositories from the SEART platform and constructed several datasets from the thresholds often applied in MSR research. We identify the maintenance bias in these filtering processes, which masks the true abandonment (73.42%) realities of OSS projects. Also, these strategies favor some ecosystems and governance styles. translated_title: 去除噪音还是引入偏差？软件仓库挖掘（MSR）数据过滤的隐性代价
translated_abstract: 像GitHub这样的开源软件（OSS）平台是软件仓库挖掘（MSR）研究的主要数据来源。由于该平台被从学生到开发者的各类用户广泛使用，并非所有仓库都是真正经过工程化管理的项目。因此，为了避免此类噪音，研究人员通常会应用若干筛选标准，但这些标准可能会从根本上改变样本的人口统计特征。为了理解这些偏差，本研究旨在揭示这些任意阈值或筛选标准所产生的隐性代价。我们分析了来自SEART平台的157万个仓库，并根据MSR研究中常用的阈值构建了多个数据集。我们识别出这些过滤过程中存在的维护偏差，这种偏差掩盖了OSS项目真实的被弃置率（73.42%）。此外，这些过滤策略还偏好某些特定的生态系统和治理风格。而且，抽样策略还会扭曲变量之间的关系，产生关系偏差。因此，为了避免……
tldr: 本研究通过对157万个GitHub仓库的分析发现，MSR研究中常用的过滤标准虽然能去除噪音，却会引入维护偏差和关系偏差，掩盖了开源项目高达73.42%的真实弃置率，并扭曲了变量间的真实关系。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that common filtering criteria in MSR research, while removing noise, introduce maintenance and relational biases that mask the true abandonment rate (73.42%) of OSS projects and distort relationships between variables.
